_comment: The fixture itself is frozen: never edit it. Record a deliberate change
here instead, one entry per expected value, and rules.rs applies it before
comparing. A disagreement with no entry here is an unintended regression.
Each entry needs: vector_id, expected, reason, design_doc.
reason and design_doc must be non-empty and design_doc must name a file
that exists -- an override nobody can trace is the silent rewrite this
mechanism exists to prevent. vector_id must name a value the fixture
actually has, so a stale entry fails instead of sitting there.
